sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the limits of bankruptcy court power. The dispute centers on whether a court can approve a settlement that distributes funds outside the statutory priority order. the sides that brought the case seek to reverse the lower court approval. the opposing sides seek to affirm that approval.
